title: Notes on the deformed Hermitian-Yang-Mills equations and the large scaling limits of stability conditions
summary: In this short note, we show that, assuming a conjecture of Arcara and Miles, a line bundle on a smooth complex projective surface admits a deformed Hermitian-Yang-Mills metric if and only if it is stable in the ``large scaling limit" with respect to a generic Kähler form. The same statement for toric surfaces was recently proved by Stoppa. The purpose of this note is to remark that this equivalence holds for arbitrary smooth projective surfaces.
